summary: Model CommonJS require with Node resolution and caching.

target.notes: Resolve, cache before/while evaluation as Node requires, execute synchronously, and return module.exports.

semantics.cache: same resolved module normally executes once and reuses its module instance

caveats: require.cache is mutable, so static once-only assumptions require proving it is untouched.

tests.name: same module is cached
